# jwt — JSON Web Tokens

[All groups](README.md)

## jwt decode

Decode a JWT without verifying it: header, claims, readable timestamps and basic sanity checks.

MCP tool: `jwt_decode`.

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `--token` | string | The JWT (CLI: @file or - for stdin). **Required.** CLI: `@path` reads a file, `-` reads stdin. |
| `--leeway` | int | Clock skew allowance in seconds. Default `60`. |

Plus the [common parameters](README.md#common-parameters).

## jwt verify

Verify a JWT signature and validate its claims. Keys come from an issuer's discovery document, a JWKS URL, an inline/file JWKS, a PEM public key or certificate, or an HMAC secret.

MCP tool: `jwt_verify`.

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `--token` | string | The JWT (CLI: @file or - for stdin). **Required.** CLI: `@path` reads a file, `-` reads stdin. |
| `--issuer` | string | Issuer URL: discover its jwks_uri and require iss to equal it. |
| `--jwks-uri` | string | JWKS URL to fetch keys from. |
| `--jwks` | string | JWKS or single JWK as inline JSON, or a path to a file. May be a file path (CLI or profile only). |
| `--pem` | string | PEM public key or certificate, inline or a path to a file. May be a file path (CLI or profile only). |
| `--secret` | string | Shared secret for HS256/384/512. Secret: falls back to `IDPDBG_SECRET`, redacted in traces. |
| `--audience` | string | Value that must appear in aud. |
| `--nonce` | string | Value the nonce claim must equal. |
| `--leeway` | int | Clock skew allowance in seconds. Default `60`. |

Plus the [common parameters](README.md#common-parameters).

## jwt sign

Create a signed JWT from JSON claims with a private key (PEM or JWK; RS/PS/ES/EdDSA) or a shared secret (HS256/384/512). Adds iat and, with expires_in, exp. For producing test tokens.

MCP tool: `jwt_sign`.

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `--claims` | json | JSON claims, e.g. {"iss":"https://issuer","sub":"alice","aud":"api"}. **Required.** |
| `--key` | string | Signing key: PEM private key or private JWK. May be a file path (CLI or profile only). Over MCP it must be passed in the call, never taken from a profile or the environment. |
| `--secret` | string | Shared secret for HS256/384/512. Secret: falls back to `IDPDBG_SECRET`, redacted in traces. Over MCP it must be passed in the call, never taken from a profile or the environment. |
| `--alg` | string | Algorithm; default follows the key (RS256, ES256/384/512, EdDSA) or HS256; PS256/384/512 for RSA-PSS. |
| `--kid` | string | kid header. |
| `--header` | json | Extra header members as a JSON object. |
| `--embed-jwk` | bool | Put the public key in the header as jwk. |
| `--iat-now` | bool | Add iat when missing. Default `true`. |
| `--expires-in` | int | Set exp this many seconds from now. |

Plus the [common parameters](README.md#common-parameters).
